rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for organized armed conflict, including a particular war.

example.english: This war lasted three years and has finally ended.
example.traditional: 呢場戰爭打咗三年，終於完喇。
example.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 zin3 zang1 daa2 zo2 saam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for one particular conflict, especially when framing it as a battle or campaign.

example.jyutping: nei1 coeng4 zoeng6 daa2 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2
